criteria.observation: Ordinary saved settings and absent keys are readable through the same exported API on the current and simulated older runtimes.
The reader distinguishes every documented own value from absence across record shapes and runtimes, reads a selected getter once and preserves the record, its prototype and runtime capabilities.

The submitted local suite passes for conforming readers on both capabilities and catches a combined legacy/saved-value regression missed by the distributed tests. Its report identifies the simulated environment.
